Manchester City vs Fulham: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Premier League title race heats up as reigning champions Manchester City host a resilient Fulham side at the Etihad Stadium. This mid-week fixture on Wednesday promises to be a captivating encounter, with City looking to maintain their dominant form and Fulham aiming to cause an upset and climb further away from the relegation zone. With both teams having distinct objectives for the remainder of the season, the tactical battle between Pep Guardiola and Marco Silva will undoubtedly be a fascinating spectacle for football fans worldwide. Kick-off: 11.02.2026, 19:30 UTC / 22:30 MSK
Stadium: Etihad Stadium
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Manchester City enter this match in formidable form, having firmly re-established themselves as genuine title contenders in recent weeks. Their attacking prowess, coupled with a newfound defensive stability, has seen them rack up a series of impressive victories. Pep Guardiola’s side will be eager to continue this momentum, especially in front of their home crowd, as they seek to exert pressure on their rivals at the top of the table. Fulham, under the astute management of Marco Silva, have shown flashes of brilliance this season. Despite a challenging run of fixtures, they have demonstrated a commendable spirit and an ability to score crucial goals. While facing City at the Etihad is arguably one of the toughest tests in the league, Fulham will take confidence from their counter-attacking potential and their capacity to frustrate bigger teams. Their ability to absorb pressure and hit on the break will be key to their chances of securing a positive result.

Team Form and Analysis

Manchester City

Manchester City's defense has been particularly solid recently, with Ruben Dias and John Stones forming a formidable partnership at the back. Their ability to swiftly transition from defense to attack is unparalleled, often spearheaded by the creative genius of Kevin De Bruyne and the clinical finishing of Erling Haaland. While there are no significant new injury concerns reported, Guardiola may opt for some rotation given the busy fixture schedule, but without compromising the team's balance. Key performers like Phil Foden and Bernardo Silva will be crucial in unlocking Fulham's defense.

Fulham

Fulham’s strength lies in their spirited midfield and the attacking threat posed by players like Andreas Pereira and Raúl Jiménez. Their defensive organization will be severely tested against City's relentless attack, and the performances of their central defenders will be paramount. João Palhinha’s presence in midfield will be vital for breaking up City’s play and winning possession. The Cottagers will likely adopt a compact defensive shape, looking to exploit any spaces left by City's advanced full-backs on the counter-attack. A strong performance from their goalkeeper will also be a prerequisite for any positive outcome.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Manchester City (4-3-3): - Ederson - Kyle Walker - Rúben Dias - John Stones - Joško Gvardiol - Rodri - Kevin De Bruyne - Bernardo Silva - Phil Foden - Erling Haaland - Jack Grealish Fulham (4-2-3-1): - Bernd Leno - Timothy Castagne - Tosin Adarabioyo - Calvin Bassey - Antonee Robinson - João Palhinha - Harrison Reed - Andreas Pereira - William Pacho - Bobby Decordova-Reid - Raúl Jiménez

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: Manchester City to Win by at least two goals. City's home form and superior individual quality are expected to overwhelm Fulham.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Manchester City's potent attack often leads to high-scoring affairs, and Fulham have shown they can contribute to the scoreboard.

Bologna vs Lazio: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the Coppa Italia reaches its crucial stages, Bologna and Lazio prepare to lock horns in what promises to be a captivating encounter. This high-stakes match sees two Serie A stalwarts vying for a coveted spot in the next round, with both sides eager to demonstrate their cup credentials. With recent league form providing mixed signals for both teams, this knockout tie offers a fresh battleground where tactics, individual brilliance, and sheer will could prove decisive. Fans can expect a fiercely contested affair as each club eyes silverware this season. Kick-off: 11.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Stadio Renato Dall'Ara
Competition: Italy - Coppa Italia

Match Preview

Bologna will host Lazio at the Stadio Renato Dall'Ara in a highly anticipated Coppa Italia clash. The Rossoblù, under the astute guidance of Thiago Motta, have shown flashes of brilliance this season, particularly at home where they often punch above their weight. Their disciplined defensive shape combined with swift counter-attacking play has made them a tough nut to crack for many top-tier opponents. However, inconsistency remains a concern, making this cup tie a true test of their resolve. Lazio, meanwhile, come into this fixture with their own ambitions firmly set on a deep cup run. Maurizio Sarri's Biancocelesti have often displayed their characteristic fluid attacking football, though they too have struggled with maintaining peak performance across all competitions. Recent results suggest a team still finding its rhythm, and a strong performance in the Coppa Italia could provide the impetus needed for a more consistent run of form in the league. With key players returning from minor knocks, Sarri will be looking to field his strongest XI to navigate this tricky away fixture.

Team Form and Analysis

Bologna

Bologna's defensive organization has been a hallmark of their season, conceding fewer goals than expected for a mid-table side. Their attack, however, has often relied on individual moments of magic from players like Riccardo Orsolini or the industrious performances of Joshua Zirkzee. Motta's tactical flexibility means they can adapt their approach, but they will need to be at their clinical best to break down a well-drilled Lazio defense. While no major new injury concerns have been reported, the physical demands of their recent league schedule could influence selection.

Lazio

Lazio's strength lies in their midfield control and the creative output from players like Luis Alberto and Mattia Zaccagni. Ciro Immobile remains their primary goal threat, and his form will be crucial for any success in front of goal. Sarri's 'Sarriball' philosophy emphasizes possession and quick transitions, but they will need to be wary of Bologna's counter-attacking prowess. Updates on a couple of minor knocks to defensive players will be monitored closely, but the expectation is that Lazio will deploy a strong lineup aimed at dominating possession and creating scoring opportunities from wide areas.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Bologna (4-2-3-1):
  • Skorupski
  • Posch, Lucumi, Calafiori, Lykogiannis
  • Freuler, Moro
  • Orsolini, Ferguson, Saelemaekers
  • Zirkzee
Lazio (4-3-3):
  • Provedel
  • Lazzari, Romagnoli, Casale, Hysaj
  • Luis Alberto, Cataldi, Vecino
  • Felipe Anderson, Immobile, Zaccagni

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: Lazio to Win
  • Reasoning: Despite Bologna's strong home record, Lazio's superior squad depth and individual quality, particularly in attack, are likely to see them through.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals
  • Reasoning: Both teams possess solid defenses, and cup ties often start cautiously, suggesting a tight affair with limited scoring opportunities.

Athletic Club vs Real Sociedad: Live Stream & Watch Online

The fierce Basque Derby takes center stage in the Copa del Rey on February 11, 2026, as Athletic Club host Real Sociedad in a highly anticipated quarter-final clash. This regional rivalry promises an intense battle, with both teams eager to secure bragging rights and a coveted spot in the semi-finals. With recent form showing defensive solidity from Athletic and attacking flair from La Real, this encounter is poised to be a tactical masterclass and a thrilling spectacle for football fans worldwide. Kick-off: 11.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: San Mamés, Bilbao
Competition: Spain - Copa del Rey

Match Preview

The San Mamés will be rocking for what is arguably the most passionate derby in Spanish football. Athletic Club comes into this game having demonstrated impressive resilience, particularly at home, making their famous stadium a fortress. Under Ernesto Valverde, they've cultivated a robust defensive structure complemented by swift transitions. Their journey through the Copa del Rey has been marked by determination, overcoming challenging opponents to reach this stage. The home crowd's energy will be a significant factor, potentially propelling the Lions to new heights. Real Sociedad, on the other hand, arrives in Bilbao with a reputation for fluid, attacking football. Imanol Alguacil's side has been a consistent presence in the upper echelons of La Liga and has shown their pedigree in cup competitions. Their midfield maestro Odegaard, alongside Oyarzabal and Isak, offers a potent threat to any defense. However, their recent form has been a mix of dominant victories and frustrating draws, suggesting a slight inconsistency that could be exploited by their arch-rivals. This Cup tie represents a golden opportunity for either side to ignite their season and deliver silverware to their passionate fanbases.

Team Form and Analysis

Athletic Club

Athletic Club’s strength lies in their collective spirit and defensive organization. Unai Simon remains a commanding presence in goal, while the defensive bedrock of Yeray Álvarez and Dani Vivian has been particularly solid. Their midfield, marshaled by Dani García and Vesga, provides a crucial shield for the backline and instigates attacks. Upfront, the pace and trickery of Nico Williams, combined with the finishing prowess of Gorka Guruzeta, make them a dangerous proposition. The potential return of Iñigo Lekue from injury could provide additional depth on the flanks, offering Valverde more tactical flexibility. Their set-piece delivery has also been a key avenue for goals.

Real Sociedad

Real Sociedad's offensive capabilities are undeniable, with their intricate passing and ability to unlock defenses. The creative hub of Martín Ødegaard, pulling the strings from midfield, is crucial to their attacking rhythm. Mikel Oyarzabal's leadership and goal-scoring threat from wide areas are vital, as is Alexander Isak's aerial presence and clinical finishing. Defensively, however, they have shown occasional vulnerabilities, particularly against quick counter-attacks. They will need to be disciplined against Athletic's direct approach. The fitness of key defender Robin Le Normand will be paramount in containing Athletic's forward line, and his presence could greatly influence the outcome.

Sunderland vs Liverpool: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Stadium of Light prepares for a titanic Premier League encounter as Sunderland host title hopefuls Liverpool. This mid-week fixture on Matchday 25 carries significant weight for both sides: Sunderland will be fighting tooth and nail to secure vital points in their bid for survival or European qualification, while Liverpool aims to solidify their position at the top or maintain pressure on their rivals in a fiercely contested title race. With contrasting ambitions but equally high stakes, this promises to be a captivating battle of wits and skill under the floodlights. Kick-off: 11.02.2026, 20:15 UTC / 23:15 MSK
Stadium: Stadium of Light
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Sunderland enters this crucial fixture following a mixed run of form that has seen them pick up valuable points against mid-table teams but struggle against the league's elite. Their manager has emphasized tactical discipline and exploiting set-piece opportunities, given Liverpool's formidable defense. The Black Cats will be leaning heavily on their home support to create an intimidating atmosphere, hoping to rattle Jurgen Klopp's well-drilled machine. Recent injury concerns for key offensive players could force a reshuffle in their attacking approach, likely favoring a more counter-attacking style. Liverpool, meanwhile, arrives in Sunderland having showcased their customary attacking prowess and defensive solidity in recent weeks. While they've had a few blips on the road this season, their overall consistency has been remarkable. Klopp will be demanding a professional performance to avoid any complacency against a team battling for their lives. The squad depth at Anfield allows for rotation, keeping key players fresh, a significant advantage as the season enters its business end. However, a physically demanding schedule and a couple of minor injury scares in their last outing might influence Klopp's starting eleven.

Team Form and Analysis

Sunderland

Sunderland's defense has shown moments of resilience, particularly when playing deep and compact, but has occasionally been susceptible to pace and intricate passing movements. Their attack often thrives on the directness of their wingers and the aerial prowess of their center-forward. The team will be buoyed by the return of their influential central midfielder from suspension, providing much-needed creativity and control in the engine room. Key performer to watch is their lead striker, whose ability to hold up the ball and link play will be crucial against Liverpool's high defensive line.

Liverpool

Liverpool's defense, marshaled by their world-class center-backs, remains one of the league's strongest, capable of stifling even the most potent attacks. Their attack, spearheaded by a dynamic front three and supported by surging full-backs, is relentlessly potent, with goals coming from various sources. Klopp might opt for a slightly altered midfield to combat Sunderland's expected physical approach, potentially bringing in a more defensive-minded player. The form of their attacking midfielder has been exceptional, providing both goals and assists, making him a central figure in their creative efforts.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Sunderland (4-2-3-1):
  • GK: Patterson
  • DF: Hume, Ballard, O'Nien, Alese
  • MF: Ekwah, Neil
  • AM: Roberts, Bellingham, Clarke
  • FW: Burstow
Liverpool (4-3-3):
  • GK: Alisson
  • DF: Alexander-Arnold, Konate, Van Dijk, Robertson
  • MF: Szoboszlai, Endo, Mac Allister
  • FW: Salah, Nunez, Diaz

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: Liverpool to Win
  • Reasoning: Liverpool's superior quality, squad depth, and current form make them strong favorites against a resilient but outmatched Sunderland side.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals
  • Reasoning: Liverpool's potent attack is expected to find the net multiple times, and Sunderland, playing at home, will push for a goal, potentially opening up the game.
